name: Fotor
description_en:
Fotor combines browser photo adjustment, AI enhancement and batch editing with design assets and generative models.

Its usefulness for a catalog shoot depends on the export tier, operation-specific credits and the license attached to each asset, rather than simply whether an editing tool is available.
description_zh:
Fotor 将浏览器照片调整、AI 增强与批量编辑结合到设计素材及生成模型中。

用于商品拍摄时，需要同时核对导出档位、各操作点数和素材许可，不能只看编辑工具是否可用。

core_features.name_en: Up to 50 images per batch upload
core_features.explanation_en: The batch guide documents JPG, PNG and WebP input, enhancement, resizing, cropping and background operations; availability and export quality remain plan dependent.
core_features.explanation_zh: 批量指南列出 JPG、PNG、WebP 输入，以及增强、缩放、裁切和背景处理；功能开放和导出质量仍受套餐影响。

core_features.name_zh: 生成与存储额度分别计算
core_features.explanation_en: The pricing matrix distinguishes concurrency, AI Agent chats/tasks, cloud capacity and credits, so a larger storage plan is not unlimited generation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 价格矩阵分别列出并发、AI Agent 对话/任务、云空间和点数；更大存储不代表无限生成。

core_features.explanation_en: Basic lists normal JPG/PNG/PDF; paid tiers list HD JPG/PNG/PDF and transparent PNG.
core_features.explanation_zh: Basic 列出普通 JPG/PNG/PDF，付费档列出高清 JPG/PNG/PDF 和透明 PNG。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_zh: 为商品照片建立可复查的批处理
sections.en:
For a small catalog shoot, first group photographs that need the same crop, background treatment and output size. Fotor’s guide describes uploading up to 50 images, selecting tools in the side panel, applying the operation and downloading the batch after review. It names one-tap enhancement, upscaling, face unblur, skin retouching and old-photo restoration alongside resize, crop, conversion and compression.

A sensible editorial workflow is to try a representative image before processing the whole group, then inspect edges, product color and labels in the outputs. AI reconstruction may create plausible detail rather than recover a faithful original. Keep source photographs separately and retain a copy before any watermark or background change. These checks are recommendations, not a completed Fotor benchmark.
sections.zh:
处理小型商品拍摄时，可先按相同裁切、背景处理和输出尺寸分组。Fotor 指南描述了上传最多 50 张图片、在侧栏选择工具、执行操作、检查后整批下载的流程。它列出一键增强、放大、人脸清晰化、皮肤修饰、老照片修复，以及缩放、裁切、格式转换和压缩。

编辑建议是先用一张有代表性的照片试处理，再扩大到整组，并检查成品边缘、商品颜色和标签。AI 重建可能补出合理细节，并不等于忠实恢复原始信息。应另存原片，在移除水印或改变背景前保留副本。这些检查属于工作流建议，未在 Fotor 中实际测试。

sections.title_en: Budget for a model and an export, not just a subscription
sections.title_zh: 预算要对应模型与导出条件
sections.en:
The rendered pricing page offered Basic plus Pro, Pro+ and Max. The actual annual browser view showed US $39.99 billed yearly for Pro, US $62.99 for the displayed Pro+ offer and US $134.32 for the selected 1,000-credit Max offer. The corresponding cards listed 100, 300 and 1,000 credits per month. These are observed offers, not guaranteed renewal amounts; other Max credit selections and business plans were not priced here. Static HTML initially contained price placeholders, so those placeholders were not treated as quotations.

Basic has limited free credits, 512 MB storage and normal JPG/PNG/PDF exports. The paid matrix lists 2 GB, 100 GB and 500 GB storage and HD/transparent exports. Concurrency rises from 1 on Basic to 10, 30 and 50 on paid tiers, independently of the credit balance. Pricing says unused subscription credits can accumulate for up to five months while subscribed. Generation costs vary by model: the visible table listed classic images at one credit and Nano Banana Pro at 15. A headline image count cannot be applied to every model or editing operation.
sections.zh:
实际渲染的价格页提供 Basic、Pro、Pro+ 和 Max。浏览器年付状态显示 Pro 每年实付 US$39.99，所显示的 Pro+ 优惠为 US$62.99，选中 1,000 点的 Max 优惠为 US$134.32；对应卡片分别列出每月 100、300 和 1,000 点。这是读取时的报价，不能保证续费金额；其他 Max 点数选项和企业套餐未在此报价。静态 HTML 起初只有价格占位符，因此未将占位符当成报价。

Basic 提供有限免费点数、512 MB 空间和普通 JPG/PNG/PDF 导出。付费矩阵列出 2 GB、100 GB、500 GB 空间及高清/透明导出。并发数从 Basic 的 1 提升到付费档的 10、30、50，与点数余额分别计算。价格页说持续订阅时未用点数最多可累计五个月。生成成本随模型变化：可见表格中 classic 图片为一点，Nano Banana Pro 为 15 点，不能将某个示例图片数套到所有模型或编辑操作。

sections.title_en: Check the finished design and the source asset separately
sections.title_zh: 分别核对成品和原始素材许可
sections.en:
The September 18, 2026 terms distinguish uploaded content, AI output and Fotor design resources. For AI output, Fotor says it currently makes no copyright claim and cannot license or release rights to the user; that is not a guarantee of protectability or freedom from third-party claims. Sample photographs, videos and music are illustrative and are not automatically licensed to subscribers.

Creative Images have a conditional in-service, template-based license, with stated commercial print limits of 10,000 and personal limits of 200 unless another license is arranged. Certain font families also have in-service restrictions. The terms additionally require finished work using paid design resources to be published within 30 days after the subscription ends, and limit further modification or creation after expiry. Those resource rules should not be generalized into ownership restrictions on every photograph a user uploads. For a client campaign, identify the actual stock image, font and template used before approving delivery.
sections.zh:
2026 年 9 月 18 日条款区分用户上传内容、AI 输出和 Fotor 设计资源。关于 AI 输出，Fotor 表示目前不主张其版权，也无法向用户授予或释放相关权利；这不保证输出可受版权保护或不涉及第三方权利。示例照片、视频和音乐用于展示，并不会自动授权给订阅用户。

Creative Images 的许可附有在平台内、基于模板使用的条件，商业印刷上限写为 10,000 份，个人为 200 份，更多用量需另行许可。部分字体也限制在平台内使用。条款还要求含付费设计资源的成品在订阅结束后 30 天内发布，并限制到期后继续修改或创作。这些资源规则不应泛化成对每一张用户上传照片的所有权限制。交付客户活动素材前，应识别实际使用的图库图片、字体和模板。

sections.title_en: Cloud storage and device sync need separate checks
sections.title_zh: 云空间和设备同步需要分别核对
sections.en:
The October 20, 2026 privacy policy says AIGC inputs and outputs are generally stored on US AWS servers for the account’s lifetime unless the user deletes them. For the avatar feature, input face data is described as deleted after successful generation, while generated avatars remain stored until deletion. The policy also describes transferring selected inputs to third-party generation providers and chatbot exchanges through MCP. This is a provider policy statement, not a network or deletion audit.

Do not read “device sync” as a universal paid entitlement: section 6.1.7 of the service terms says payments and subscriptions are platform specific and not transferable among website, desktop and mobile platforms. Confirm the checkout platform and the intended editing application together. Fotor also says its service is not a backup solution, even when the plan includes cloud capacity.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 20 日隐私政策称，AIGC 输入和输出通常保存在美国 AWS 服务器上，保留期一般随账户持续，除非用户删除。对于头像功能，输入人脸数据被描述为在成功生成后删除，而生成的头像会留存到用户删除。政策还描述了将选定输入传给第三方生成模型，以及通过 MCP 与聊天机器人交换内容。这是厂商政策说明，未做网络或删除审计。

不能将“设备同步”理解为所有平台均享有同一付费权益：服务条款 6.1.7 写明网站、桌面和移动端的付款及订阅按平台区分，不能互转。应同时核对结账平台和准备使用的编辑应用。即使套餐提供云空间，Fotor 也声明服务不是备份方案。

sections.en:
The terms describe automatic renewal, cancellation taking effect at the end of the current period and a request deadline at least 24 hours before expiry. Subscription fees are described as nonrefundable, subject to applicable law. Before canceling a production account, export needed work and review the paid-resource publication conditions rather than relying on future access to cloud projects.

Fotor is a documentation-based candidate for people who need common photo and design operations in one place. Exact batch credit charges, difficult-subject masking accuracy, lossless color handling, editable export fidelity and cross-device entitlement were not tested. A team should compare those specific requirements against the relevant plan instead of inferring suitability from the number of listed AI models.
sections.zh:
条款描述自动续费，取消在当前周期结束时生效，并要求至少提前 24 小时提交取消请求。订阅费被列为不可退款，仍受适用法律约束。取消生产使用账户前，应导出需要的作品并核对付费资源的发布条件，不能依赖以后仍可访问云项目。

从文档看，Fotor 可作为希望在同一平台处理常见照片和设计操作的候选。具体批量操作点数、复杂主体抠图准确率、无损色彩处理、可编辑格式保真度和跨设备权益均未实测。团队应将这些要求与具体套餐对照，而不是根据 AI 模型数量推定适用性。
